model_scope_note.clarification: The 2-gene collapse (CXCL12,POSTN) is the Core-13 model. The Full-28 model retains 12 non-zero genes and does NOT collapse to two; it also does not transfer OOD (platinum AUROC 0.598, p=0.139, NOT-SUPPORTED). The parsimonious 2-gene Core-13 is the frozen, carried-forward model.

w1_coef_stability.caveat: Discovery-only. EPV~0.36 (10 minority events / 13 features). Low-EPV drives wide fold spread; bootstrap stability quantifies fragility honestly.

quantile_norm_sensitivity.interpretation: AUROC is rank-based; quantile normalization of active genes changes absolute scores but should barely move AUROC, confirming discrimination survives the batch shift while the operating threshold does not.

w2_batch_effect.composite_context: Prior frozen composite IMMUNE_ACCESS=0.40*TCELL_GPS-0.35*MYELOID_FLOOD-0.25*STROMAL_CAGE was NOT_SUPPORTED across 9 configs (GSE63885 platinum AUROC 0.549z/0.579raw, p=0.474/0.239). Core-13 Elastic Net (0.638) is a DIFFERENT model; both verdicts real.
w2_batch_effect.caveat: Batch shift ~4.5 log2 on CXCL12/POSTN breaks frozen Youden threshold (sens 0.00-0.07, spec 1.0) but not rank-based AUROC. Deployment needs cross-cohort calibration.

known_prior_facts.note: TCGA n=427 3-tier SPE is PROGNOSTIC only (prior mission fact). This cohort analysis is corroborating, discovery-only, RUO.

w3_survival.caveat: Cohort-level prognostic association, discovery-only, small n. PROGNOSTIC (who progresses) is distinct from PREDICTIVE platinum-response (Elastic Net). Not a validated clinical tool.

w4_gene_screen.interpretation: Univariate out-of-distribution screen. Identifies which single genes carry standalone platinum-sensitivity signal after BH-FDR. Contextualizes whether the 2-gene Elastic Net core reflects the strongest individual drivers.
w4_gene_screen.caveat: Discovery-only, out-of-distribution, RUO. Raw-gene AUROC without orientation correction; |AUROC-0.5| measures discrimination magnitude in either direction.

artistry7_verified.outcome: FAILED interim OS: nemvaleukin+pembro median OS 10.1mo vs chemo 9.8mo (HR 0.98); development halted for PROC; 456 patients; terminated
artistry7_verified.usage_note: Illustrative real-world example of failed IO in cold/stromal-rich tumor. NOT a claim CrisPRO could have rescued it (no access to ARTISTRY-7 biomarker data). Hypothesis-generating only.
